title: What options you have when creating Agents (Optional DeepDive)

cues.en: In this video, we are going to go deep dive into what Create AI Agent can do.
cues.zh: 這段影片要深入介紹 CreateAIAgent 能做哪些事情。

cues.en: We will show every single little thing you can do with this in the various two overloads, and some of them we will just
cues.zh: 我們會看兩種多載中的每一個選項，有些先簡單提到，

cues.en: talk about, and there will be dedicated videos on.
cues.zh: 之後會有專門影片詳細介紹。

cues.en: Others we will just mention for your own self-discovery, but let's have a look.
cues.zh: 其他選項則留給你自己探索。現在來看看。

cues.en: So what you can see is we have two overloads.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這裡有兩個多載。

cues.en: One takes a chat client agent options, and then it takes a client factory, and a logger factory, and a service provider.
cues.zh: 一個接收 ChatClientAgentOptions，再接 ClientFactory、LoggerFactory 和 ServiceProvider。

cues.en: The other one takes instructions, name, description, tools, client factory, logger factory, and services.
cues.zh: 另一個接收 Instructions、Name、Description、Tools、ClientFactory、LoggerFactory 與 Services。

cues.en: So we can see the last three are the same, while this one is just one that gives a little less options than what
cues.zh: 所以最後三個參數相同，前面這個簡化版提供的選項，比完整的

cues.en: is inside this chat client.
cues.zh: ChatClientAgentOptions 少一些。

cues.en: So let's start with this.
cues.zh: 先從這個版本開始。

cues.en: The first thing we can set is the instructions, and as we saw in the prompt video, that is just what we can steer
cues.zh: 第一個能設定的是 Instructions。提示詞影片裡看過，它能引導

cues.en: the model and speak like about it.
cues.zh: 模型，例如讓它用海盜口吻說話。

cues.en: Next, we can give the agent a name.
cues.zh: 接著，可以替代理程式取個名字。

cues.en: Names are not really something that I used for the LLM.
cues.zh: 名稱主要不是給 LLM 使用的，

cues.en: It's not like it's getting a name that's called my agent or anything, but when we use these agents across various different things in
cues.zh: 並不是讓模型自稱 My Agent。不過在 Agent Framework 裡，代理程式可能會用在

cues.en: agent framework, like workflows and agents within agents and stuff, it might be beneficial to give
cues.zh: 工作流程，或代理程式內再呼叫其他代理程式等情境，因此取一個

cues.en: a name instead of just an ID that we don't know.
cues.zh: 名字，比只看到不認識的 ID 更容易辨識。

cues.en: So we can give something like this, my agent, and then it will be identified as.
cues.zh: 例如這裡命名為 My Agent，之後就用這個名稱識別。

cues.en: There's a few odd cases where name is actually mandatory, because it's actually being used by some features.
cues.zh: 某些比較特殊的情境中，名稱是必填的，因為有功能會用到它。

cues.en: For example, something called dev UI needs a name.
cues.zh: 例如 DevUI 就需要名稱。

cues.en: The next field is description, and description is absolutely optional.
cues.zh: 下一個是 Description，這完全是選填的。

cues.en: It's not really used for anything.
cues.zh: 它不太會被拿來實際執行什麼功能，

cues.en: I have not seen it being used in the other end.
cues.zh: 我目前也沒看過接收端特別使用它。

cues.en: So the only thing you can really use it for is when you sit with an agent and can perhaps see its description.
cues.zh: 主要用途就是你在檢視代理程式時，可以查看它的描述。

cues.en: So it's purely informational.
cues.zh: 因此純粹是說明資訊。

cues.en: I have personally never used it, but it is possible to write something about what this agent do if need be.
cues.zh: 我自己沒什麼用過，但有需要時，可以寫上這個代理程式的用途。

cues.en: Then there's tools.
cues.zh: 接著是 Tools。

cues.en: Tools we will leave for the dedicated section about tools, but this is where we put in tool calling so we can have the
cues.zh: 工具會留到專門章節介紹。這裡是放入工具呼叫的地方，讓

cues.en: system do various reach out to different action tools and information tools.
cues.zh: 系統能使用各種動作工具或資訊工具。

cues.en: Then there's something called the client factory.
cues.zh: 再來是 ClientFactory。

cues.en: This is a very, very low level step where we can go in and get the underlying iChat clients, which happens behind the AI
cues.zh: 這是一個非常底層的切入點，可以取得 AIAgent 背後的 IChatClient，

cues.en: agent, and manipulate that.
cues.zh: 並對它進行操作。

cues.en: So we can go in and get this agent, and we need to return it again after we are done.
cues.zh: 我們取得這個用戶端，處理完成後還需要把它回傳。

cues.en: So let's set the breakpoint here.
cues.zh: 在這裡設個中斷點，

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: So we need to do that, and then on this chat client, we can begin to use it in its raw format.
cues.zh: 取得 ChatClient 後，就可以直接以它原本的形式操作。

cues.en: Not really ever so far been a need for me, but if you really, really need to go deep, you can actually get down
cues.zh: 到目前為止，我幾乎沒有這種需求，但如果真的需要深入，確實可以下到

cues.en: to that level.
cues.zh: 這一層。

cues.en: Then we have the logger factory, which is just the normal iLogger system.
cues.zh: 接著是 LoggerFactory，也就是一般的 ILogger 記錄機制。

cues.en: So if you want to put in logging for your agent, it is possible here on a fairly low level.
cues.zh: 如果想替代理程式加入記錄，可以在這個相當底層的位置設定。

cues.en: There is middleware as well for logging, which we will cover in later videos.
cues.zh: 也可以透過中介軟體記錄，後續影片會介紹。

cues.en: But here we could make some loggers.
cues.zh: 這裡則可以建立記錄器。

cues.en: And the final thing is we can add an iServiceProvider as a dependency injection here.
cues.zh: 最後，可以傳入 IServiceProvider，作為相依性注入的來源。

cues.en: So AI tools should be able to use this.
cues.zh: AI 工具就能使用其中的服務。

cues.en: I will show a dedicated video on this as well in the advanced section of this.
cues.zh: 進階章節也會有專門影片介紹這個功能。

cues.en: It is fairly niche to use, but it is possible to do.
cues.zh: 使用情境比較特殊，但確實能做到。

cues.en: So that is the easy version of it all.
cues.zh: 以上是比較簡單的版本。

cues.en: We can also take the approach where we actually give an entire object here.
cues.zh: 也可以採用直接傳入完整選項物件的方式。

cues.en: This one gives even more options.
cues.zh: 這個方式提供更多選項。

cues.en: It also has the other ones, but we just saw them, so I won't cover them here.
cues.zh: 剛才那些參數它也都有，就不重複介紹了。

cues.en: We need two more of these.
cues.zh: 這裡還要補上兩個參數。

cues.en: What am I missing?
cues.zh: 我少了哪一個？

cues.en: That's the one for that one.
cues.zh: 這個是對應這裡的。

cues.en: No matter.
cues.zh: 沒關係。

cues.en: So here we can also give the name.
cues.zh: 在這裡同樣可以設定 Name，

cues.en: We can even give an ID if we want to.
cues.zh: 甚至可以自行指定 ID。

cues.en: Else it will auto-generate one.
cues.zh: 否則會自動產生一個。

cues.en: We can give the description.
cues.zh: 也可以提供 Description。

cues.en: And we can control what is called a chat message store factory.
cues.zh: 還能控制 ChatMessageStoreFactory。

cues.en: So whenever we use the conversation chat loop, we have the agent thread.
cues.zh: 先前對話迴圈會使用 AgentThread，

cues.en: Behind the scenes it had a chat message.
cues.zh: 它背後有儲存對話訊息的機制。

cues.en: So if we wanted to have those messages, which were just in memory, were for example stored in a SQL server or on the
cues.zh: 如果希望那些原本只在記憶體中的訊息，改存到 SQL Server 或

cues.en: disc, we could override that by putting that in here.
cues.zh: 磁碟，就可以在這裡取代預設實作。

cues.en: So that's the option.
cues.zh: 這就是這個選項的用途。

cues.en: We will have a dedicated video on that in the advanced section.
cues.zh: 進階章節會有專門影片介紹。

cues.en: We also have an AI context provider factory.
cues.zh: 另外還有 AIContextProviderFactory。

cues.en: This is a place where we can go in and do a pre and post LLM call, where we can go in and check
cues.zh: 這個位置可以在 LLM 呼叫前後介入，

cues.en: before the LLM call is being called, do something.
cues.zh: 也就是呼叫 LLM 之前先做一些事情，

cues.en: And after the LLM has been called and it's given the response back, do something.
cues.zh: 等 LLM 呼叫完成、拿到回應後，再做一些事情。

cues.en: This is good for, for example, implementing memory into an agent, and we will have a dedicated video on that as well.
cues.zh: 例如適合用來替代理程式加入記憶功能，這也會有專門影片介紹。

cues.en: We also have chat options, and this is again a lower level place.
cues.zh: 接著是 ChatOptions，同樣屬於比較底層的設定。

cues.en: And this is what, if you begin to set something here, it is what the agent framework team is calling breaking glass, meaning you
cues.zh: 當你開始設定這裡的選項時，Agent Framework 團隊稱為 Breaking Glass，意思是

cues.en: can go to the lower level parts of everything.
cues.zh: 打開底層的控制能力。

cues.en: It's in here, you can set the instructions if you don't use the other overload.
cues.zh: 如果不是使用另一個多載，也可以在這裡設定 Instructions，

cues.en: So that is not really breaking glass, but then you get to some advanced stuff like
cues.zh: 這還不算很深入。但再往下就會看到進階選項，例如

cues.en: continuation tokens, allow multiple tool calls, background responses.
cues.zh: ContinuationToken、AllowMultipleToolCalls、BackgroundResponses。

cues.en: Some of these we will cover, others we won't, because this is very, very low level.
cues.zh: 有些會在課程介紹，有些不會，因為層級真的非常底層。

cues.en: But there are certain things like, for example, max output tokens, which is a requirement of Claude, the Entropic provider.
cues.zh: 但有些設定確實會用到，例如 MaxOutputTokens，這是 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型所要求的。

cues.en: So there we would need to set that.
cues.zh: 使用那些模型時，就必須在這裡設定。

cues.en: We can set the model directly here, if we for some reason don't have access to it up in the way we generate the
cues.zh: 如果建立代理程式時，無法用原本的方式指定模型，也可以在這裡直接設定，

cues.en: agent itself.
cues.zh: 交給代理程式使用。

cues.en: That is for certain models that we need to do that.
cues.zh: 某些模型就需要採取這個方式。

cues.en: But the main thing is this raw representation factory, where we can go in and set things like thinking modes and stuff like that,
cues.zh: 不過，最重要的是 RawRepresentationFactory，可以在這裡設定思考模式等選項，

cues.en: because that is very, very provider specific.
cues.zh: 因為這些選項非常依賴供應商。

cues.en: So this raw representation factory is one of the places you go and do that.
cues.zh: 所以 RawRepresentationFactory 就是可以設定它們的地方之一。

cues.en: The response format is also a place where you can go in and begin to work with structured output, which we'll also cover in a later session.
cues.zh: ResponseFormat 則能設定結構化輸出，後面章節也會介紹。

cues.en: Temperatures, which is kind of the thing you did in the past with the older models, where you set temperature to zero to make it less random.
cues.zh: Temperature 是過去較舊模型常用的選項，例如設為零，讓隨機性降低。

cues.en: You can still do that, but very, very rarely used anymore.
cues.zh: 現在仍然可以設定，但實際上越來越少使用。

cues.en: And here we can set the tools as well.
cues.zh: 這裡同樣可以設定工具。

cues.en: So there's a lot of options in here, if you need to really, really go deep.
cues.zh: 所以，如果需要深入控制，這裡確實有很多選項。

cues.en: We won't need to do that too often, but especially for reasoning, we are going to use this, but again, dedicated videos on that.
cues.zh: 我們通常不必常常這樣做，但推理相關功能尤其會用到；這些也有專門影片。

cues.en: So that is actually everything that is here in order for you to begin to explore that there's a much deeper layer here, if
cues.zh: 以上介紹，是讓你知道還有更深入的一層，需要時可以繼續

cues.en: need be.
cues.zh: 探索。

cues.en: But for now, we will probably stick mostly to putting the instructions, which is to me
cues.zh: 目前大多只會設定 Instructions，我個人覺得

cues.en: kind of mandatory to always set, then tools.
cues.zh: 這是幾乎每次都該設定的，再來就是 Tools。

cues.en: Those are the two you would use in day-to-day and the rest is for more niche scenarios.
cues.zh: 這兩個是日常最常用的選項，其餘則適合比較特殊的情境。
